title: Read the system
detail: We read the code and the incidents before proposing anything. No discovery theatre.

title: Agree the shape
detail: A written architecture with the trade-offs stated, so disagreement happens on paper.

title: Ship in slices
detail: Something runs in production early and keeps running. No integration phase at the end.

title: Hand over, or stay
detail: Your team owns it with the reasoning written down — or we keep the pager. Your call.
